units.source_text: 微微月光下，表兄站在庭院一隅的一颗干枯的扁柏树下，仰望夜空。

en.t: In the faint moonlight, her cousin stood under a withered cypress tree in one corner of the garden, looking up at the night sky.
The grass grows so thickly here.

units.source_text: 荒凉的庭院令信子有点害怕，

en.t: The desolate garden made Nobuko a little afraid,

units.source_text: 她小心翼翼的靠近俊吉，

en.t: she cautiously drew closer to Shunkichi,

units.source_text: 可是俊吉依旧仰望夜空，低喃道：“今天是阴历十三呢，

en.t: but Shunkichi kept looking up at the night sky and murmured, Today is the thirteenth day of the lunar month,
so that is why the moon looks like this.
